name: Knucklehead

items.name: Tighten Grip
items.text:
Trigger A creature Grabbed or Restrained by the knucklehead attempts to Escape

---
Effect The DC of the Escape check is increased by 2 and the creature takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: All Fours
items.text: The knucklehead drops to all fours, or stands upright. While on all fours and not Prone, the knucklehead's walking Speed is 50 feet, its long-jump and high-jump distance is equal to its Speed, and it can't use its arm hand Strike.

items.name: Devouring Squeeze
items.text:
Requirements The knucklehead has a creature Restrained in its head hand

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The knucklehead squeezes the creature, gnawing hungrily through both armor and flesh. The creature takes 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage, and if the creature is wearing armor with Hardness 14 or lower, the armor is Broken. If the creature isn't wearing armor or if its armor is already broken, the creature instead takes an additional 2d10 piercing damage, and the knucklehead regains Hit Points equal to the amount of piercing damage dealt.

items.name: Ground Slam
items.text: The knucklehead slams the ground with an arm hand. The ground in a 10-foot emanation becomes difficult terrain. If the knucklehead has a creature Grabbed or Restrained in its arm hand, that creature takes 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage. Other creatures in the area take 3d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic DC 30 Reflex save save. A creature that fails the save also falls Prone.

items.name: Shattering Punch
items.text: The knucklehead's arm hand Strikes ignore an object's Hardness. If the knucklehead Strikes a stone surface, it breaks off a boulder-sized chunk of stone, which it can use to make rock Strikes.

items.name: Switch Hands
items.text:
Requirements The knucklehead has a creature Grabbed or Restrained in one of its arm hands

---
Effect The knucklehead moves the creature to its head hand. The creature is restrained. While the creature is restrained, they can't breathe or talk. The knucklehead can't have more than one creature restrained in its head hand.

text:
Knuckleheads are fleshwarps named after the oversized hand that sprouts from their neck in place of a skull. Their dangling, armor-plated arms are equally disproportionate, even in comparison to their massive frames, which range in size from 10 to 14 feet tall. Knuckleheads can use their arms either as a second pair of legs or to deliver stone-shattering punches. They feed by crushing a victim in their head-hand, the palm of which is split by a toothy maw.

---
It's often said that encountering a fleshwarp is evidence there's an even greater monster nearby: the cruel being that tortured the fleshwarp into its distorted form. The Darklands are home to many such monsters, both the fleshwarps and their creators.
Failed Experiments
Knuckleheads are the product of an effort to turn prisoners into obedient servants, but it turns out that a brain isn't an optional luxury when creating the perfect laborer. Driven by hunger and blind instinct, knuckleheads hunted their creators and fellow prisoners alike. Now that they've escaped into the Darklands, they prowl pitch-black caverns, attracted by the smell of flesh.
